hints.title: Two-Pass In-Place Strategy
hints.text: Directly shifting elements rightward on every zero takes quadratic time. Instead, first count how many zeros will actually fit within the fixed array boundary.

hints.title: Boundary Zero Handling
hints.text: If a zero falls exactly on the final array slot without room for its clone, copy a single zero to the end and reduce the effective array size by 1.

hints.title: Backward Writing
hints.text: Traverse backward from the last source index. Copy non-zero elements once and zeros twice into the target position j = source_idx + zeros.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Shifting remaining elements on each zero copy produces O(N^2) worst-case time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting fitting zeros followed by backward in-place copying runs in O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should perform the modification strictly in-place without allocating a temporary copy array.
complexity.notes: Backward copy prevents overwriting unread elements.
